Kinds: 30 object kinds, weights 1 to 14, adding up to 168. Each card title shows its share. Room kinds are picked apart from these.

1936.content:
Roll: per chunk, zero, one or two wall marks. The chance of a mark is 18 in 100 plus 34 times the chunk's dirt level. A second mark comes 30 times in 100.
Odds: each mark is a glitch 55 in 100, glossolalia 16, a readable phrase 15 and a tally 14. A readable phrase is one of 168 wall lines, so one given line turns up about 1 in 1,120 marks.
Gate: a clean chunk, with dirt level 0, gets no wall marks.
Corridor lines: the subtitle strip picks one random line per moment, from that moment's lines.
